name: Yun
source:
An apprentice angel who descended from heavens to earth to take a graduation exam and become an official angel. She appears in front of [url=/c57817]Kirioka Taiki[/url], who she decided to be the "subject" of her exam and moves into the abandoned dormitory he calls home. Although Yun has a bright and innocent personality, she is also capricious and known for having a sharp tongue.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20080527210151/http://www.kid-game.co.jp/kid/game/monochrome/html/mainfr2.html]game's OHP[/url] and the [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monochrome_(%E3%82%B2%E3%83%BC%E3%83%A0)]Japanese Wikipedia[/url].]
